policy.wearing: Visibly identifiable protective eyewear correctly covers both eyes. No certification of protective rating is inferred.
policy.not_wearing: No protective eyewear, ordinary eyeglasses, sunglasses, or eyewear on forehead/head.
policy.excluded: Uncertain type, invisible/occluded eye region, motion blur, incomplete head, or eye box below 48x24 native pixels where applicable.
policy.crop: PPEs eye-derived explicit box x-.25w,y-.9w,x+1.25w,y+1.05w, bounds limited to image, followed by full visual crop inspection. SH17 original VOC head expanded 5%, visually checked. Minimum crop short side 64; no enhancement or offline augmentation. Minor original hair/helmet edge clipping is allowed only when forehead, eyes, eyewear and chin remain usable; a second visible head is excluded.
policy.grouping: All PPEs frames in one factory group; SH17 visually related series joined, nearby source IDs conservatively joined; no face identification or embedding. Unavailable original photographer/identity metadata remains a limitation.

final_crop_review_scope: All 198 draft head crops visually inspected; 7 additionally excluded, 191 remaining boxes unchanged.
